title: Feedback-08: isolated stock-Sable ten-substep impact comparison, not a production repair
acceptance_criteria: The test-only comparison preparation and actual-setting guard compile and pass focused checks without changing production physics, dependencies, default configuration, owner data or the accepted wall fix.

Preparation creates only the designated fresh comparison directory with Sable's supported sub_level_substeps_per_tick set to 10, refuses existing targets, and never copies, deletes or overwrites owner configuration or worlds.

Each existing 20/40/80 probe confirms an effective SDK substepsPerTick value of 10 before launch; mismatch fails setup. The existing geometry, motion, penetration thresholds and immutable physical-failure criteria remain unchanged.

All three native comparison probes pass their unchanged physical assertions; record actual selected/discovered and pass/fail counts, each trajectory outcome, aggregate completion and clean save/shutdown. Any physical failure remains a failed native gate, not an expected-failure pass.
manual_steps: No owner testing, client launch, GUI automation, packaging, installation or owner configuration changes.
This candidate compares only an isolated ten-substep condition. Baseline two-substep R3 remains 1 pass / 2 physical failures; do not reinterpret it as passed or repaired.

Even a comparison pass is not a production fix, performance acceptance, M1 acceptance or permission to advance M2-M6. Higher substeps affect global Sable physics work; production adoption requires a separate decision and evidence.
